column1: # Domain matrix for coverage row resources (bounded memory/time/fd/disk/step budgets, recovery and UNKNOWN handling).
# Parent stays NOT_READY until every required cell is observed on the same candidate on all six native hosts.
# COVERED_LOCAL = a registered IMPLEMENTED lnx/x86_64 batch asserts exactly this requirement (Root7a/SID4fe; re-run on the next candidate).
# Unrun, PREPARED, pending and partial assertions are never COVERED.
# Required outcome vocabulary (prd.md:105-110 invariants 1 and 5; spec.md TP-8):
#   ACCEPT        rc0 with the exact oracle bytes.
#   NAMED_REFUSAL declared rc (1 language, 2 interface/runtime, 3 step budget) + exact named stderr + empty stdout + no output file.
#   PRODUCT_FAIL  signal death, unnamed rc, partial/garbage output, or accept with wrong bytes => FAIL (product defect).
#   UNKNOWN       harness deadline hit or host-imposed budget killed the process (SIGKILL/SIGXCPU/bound rc142): never PASS,
#                 never counted as a product refusal, keeps the parent unresolved, all descendants reaped, rerun required.
#   NOT_RUN       harness could not impose the condition (setrlimit/fork/mkfifo failure, missing /dev/full).
# Current gap: tests/run-batch.cx:33-36 folds a transport timeout into status=FAIL; tests/cxlib/netpack.cx:803-806 counts only
#   idle milliseconds and SIGKILLs only the direct child. The runner cells below specify the required UNKNOWN semantics.
# status: COVERED_LOCAL | MISSING | NEEDS_PRODUCT_CHANGE | NEEDS_FOREIGN_HOST | BLOCKED:<reason>
